title: Personalized neoantigen-pulsed autologous dendritic cells in newly-diagnosed glioblastoma: a phase Ib trial
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 04 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-75066-w

Newly diagnosed glioblastoma (nGBM) remains a major unmet clinical need with limited effective therapeutic options. This phase 1b trial reports safety and preliminary efficacy outcomes of nGBM patients treated with neoantigen-pulsed autologous dendritic cell vaccination.

title: Ancient plume-reinforced lithosphere modulates present-day crustal fluid migration and deformation
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 04 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-75203-5

Using geophysical imaging and numerical modelling, the authors suggest that remnants of the 260- million-year-old Emeishan mantle plume may still influence how crustal fluids move and where deformation and earthquakes occur in southwest China.

title: Sub-parts-per-billion CO<sub>2</sub> Detection based on Dissipative Whispering Gallery Mode Microcavity Sensor
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 04 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-75218-y

A whispering gallery mode microcavity detects CO2 through a dissipative sensing mechanism, achieving sub-part-per-billion sensitivity. The approach overcomes key limitation of conventional microcavity gas sensors while remaining compact and low cost.

title: Ectomesenchyme contributes to epidermal stem cell formation through mesenchymal-to-epithelial transition
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 04 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-75278-0

Here they show that some epidermal stem cells arise from ectomesenchyme, possibly near the border between neuroectoderm and epidermal ectoderm, revealing a new route of skin development.

title: Direct extraction of bromine from seawater through an electrolysis-driven styrene enrichment process
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 03 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-75016-6

Direct bromine extraction from seawater holds promise for sustainable bromine production but remains challenging. Here, the authors report an electrolysis-driven styrene enrichment process that captures and concentrates bromine species, enabling selective bromine extraction directly from seawater.

title: Structural and mechanistic insights into primer synthesis initiation by DNA primase
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 03 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-74862-8

DNA primases synthesize short primers that allow DNA polymerases to initiate genome replication, yet the mechanism of primer initiation remains unclear. Here, the authors show how an ancillary domain assembles and proofreads the first two nucleotides, ensuring efficient and accurate dinucleotide formation.

title: Spatial transcriptomic atlas of aggressive osteosarcomas reveals shared immune landscape and targetable surface markers
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 03 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-74603-x

Osteosarcoma shows marked cellular heterogeneity that complicates treatment. Here, authors use spatial transcriptomics of primary and metastatic tumors to identify a shared 9-gene cell-surface signature and distinct immune patterns, highlighting potential diagnostic and therapeutic targets.
